title: Brik Wrapper Context v1
description: Contract for the BRIK_* environment that any wrapper (shared-libs/gitlab, shared-libs/jenkins, shared-libs/local, shared-libs/common base) MUST export before delegating to lib/pipeline/. v1 captures the cross-platform contract currently observed (shared-libs/common/scripts/base-wrapper.sh + shared-libs/{gitlab,jenkins}/scripts/*-wrapper.sh). The wrapper translates CI-native variables (CI_COMMIT_SHA, GIT_COMMIT, WORKSPACE, ...) into the canonical BRIK_* contract, decoupling lib/pipeline/ from the orchestrator. Validation target: a JSON snapshot of the BRIK_* environment captured right after wrapper init.

BRIK_HOME.description: Absolute path to the brik runtime root (base-wrapper.sh line 61).

BRIK_WORKSPACE.description: Absolute path to the project workspace, defaults to BRIK_PROJECT_DIR (base-wrapper.sh line 85).

BRIK_CONFIG_FILE.description: Absolute path to brik.yml, defaults to ${BRIK_PROJECT_DIR}/brik.yml (base-wrapper.sh line 86).

BRIK_LIB_EXTENSIONS.description: Colon-separated list of absolute paths searched for brik lib modules (base-wrapper.sh line 93).

BRIK_LOG_DIR.description: Absolute path to the per-run logs directory. Mapped to ${CI_PROJECT_DIR}/.brik-logs on GitLab, ${WORKSPACE}/.brik-logs on Jenkins.

BRIK_PROJECT_DIR.description: Absolute path to the project root checkout. Mapped from CI_PROJECT_DIR (GitLab) or WORKSPACE (Jenkins).

BRIK_PLATFORM.description: Orchestrator hosting this run. Set by each wrapper as a const literal.

BRIK_BRANCH.description: Branch name. Empty string on tag-push pipelines. Mapped from CI_COMMIT_BRANCH (GitLab) or BRANCH_NAME (Jenkins).

BRIK_TAG.description: Tag name. Empty string on branch-push pipelines. Mapped from CI_COMMIT_TAG (GitLab) or TAG_NAME (Jenkins).

BRIK_COMMIT_SHA.description: Full 40-character git commit SHA. Mapped from CI_COMMIT_SHA (GitLab) or GIT_COMMIT (Jenkins).

BRIK_COMMIT_REF.description: Human-readable ref name (branch or tag). Mapped from CI_COMMIT_REF_NAME (GitLab) or derived from BRIK_BRANCH/BRIK_TAG (Jenkins).

BRIK_PIPELINE_SOURCE.description: Trigger source. v1 enum mirrors observed values: 'push' (default on Jenkins + GitLab branch/tag pushes), 'merge_request_event' (GitLab MR pipelines and Jenkins merge/pull request builds, surfaced via CHANGE_ID), 'schedule' (cron), 'web' (manual UI trigger), 'api' (programmatic trigger).

BRIK_MERGE_REQUEST_ID.description: Merge request / pull request id when applicable, empty string otherwise. Mapped from CI_MERGE_REQUEST_IID (GitLab) or CHANGE_ID (Jenkins).
